Our Architecture Process

Eight clear stages from the first brief to the final construction package.

Typical timeline: 4–12 weeks, depending on project size and authority processing.

Brief & Site Survey

We understand the requirements, visit the site, take measurements and check the relevant zoning and bylaws.

Site Survey

Boundaries, levels, access, utilities and neighbouring structures are recorded in detail.

Concept Design, 2D + 3D

Floor plans, elevations and 3D views establish the design. Two revision rounds are included.

Design Development

Dimensions, materials, structural grids and service zones are technically resolved.

Working Drawings

Plans, sections, elevations and details are prepared in AutoCAD or Revit.

Authority Submission

The required drawing set is prepared and coordinated with the relevant authority.

Structural Coordination

We align the architecture with the structural engineering team for buildability.

Final Handover

The complete construction-ready drawing package is issued to the client or contractor.

Architecture vs Interior Design vs Fit-Out

The right service depends on whether you are designing the building, planning its rooms or constructing the finished space.

Building

Architecture

  • Building form and floor plans
  • Working drawings and elevations
  • Authority submissions
  • Structural coordination
Inside

Interior Design

  • Room layouts and furniture
  • Materials and lighting
  • Design drawings
  • 3D interior views
Build

Fit-Out

  • Shell completion
  • MEP and finishes
  • Joinery and furniture
  • Snagging and handover

Need all three? Ask Woodex to coordinate architecture, interior design and fit-out as one project.

Talk through the scope

Architecture Questions, Answered

An architect designs the building: its layout, form, elevations and spatial experience. A civil or structural engineer designs the beams, columns and foundations. Woodex handles the architecture and coordinates the structural team.

Requirements vary by project and authority. PCATP registration may be needed for some commercial, multi-unit or formal submissions. Woodex has PCATP-certified architects and can advise on your project.

A typical 5–10 Marla house takes about 4–6 weeks, while a 1–2 Kanal house may take 6–10 weeks. Authority processing is separate.

The standard scope includes concept plans, 3D views, design development, working drawings and submission preparation. Structural coordination is included for full-package projects. Government fees are separate.

Yes. The standalone elevation service includes a photorealistic 3D facade view and a 2D elevation drawing for your contractor.

Yes. Site visits outside Lahore are arranged separately, and much of the review process can be handled through virtual meetings and digital drawings.

Yes. These can be commissioned as coordinated services, giving you one team from building design through the finished interior.

Yes, but late changes can affect drawings, coordination, approvals, cost and timing. We review the impact with you before revising the approved package.
